The left margin and the bottom of the page show no independent writing apart from the items listed.

page_annotations: Faint mirrored show-through of fol. 230 recto covers much of the page. It is not target text.
A small dark spot mid-page (about [1225,2360]) is a non-text mark.
Writing beyond the gutter (x>3215), including 'd.' shelfmark letters and the circled 'Bhav', belongs to fol. 231 and is excluded.
No writing was found in the top area, the bottom area or the left margin apart from the recorded items.
unresolved_relationships: It is unconfirmed whether r002, r003 and r004 query the Kāśīnātha attribution in the Lagnacandrikā entry on fol. 231 (source_order 461).

coverage.finding: The ink folio number '230' is at the top-left corner, with a raised 'b' and a small dot at the lower right of the 'b'. r001 represents it. The dot's function remains uncertain.

The faint diagonal pencil word is confirmed at about [2490,2910,320,300]. The native tile shows a dot beneath the n-like letter, an overbar above the later letters, a short dash and a question mark above right. The reading 'kaśiṇām' remains uncertain. r002's relationship evidence wrongly states that the note is level with the fol. 231 Lagnacandrikā entry.

The pencil letter with a dot beneath it and a question mark is confirmed at about [2890,3070,105,130]. The same marks show at the left edge of the fol. 231 image, which supports their being target-page writing.

The circled pencil 'Kāśīnāth[a?]' is confirmed. The oval's line continues as a tail down and to the left, ending near x≈2480, y≈3640. The ending of the word remains cramped. The note sits at about the same height as the Lagnacandrikā entry on fol. 231, but no connecting mark crosses the gutter.
The dark note 'U·1-33. 1.0, 3099.' is confirmed at lower left. Small dots appear within '1.0' and possibly beneath the '33'. These details are not fully captured in the record's uncertainties.

before.evidence: This pencil query lies near the gutter, at roughly the same height as the facing fol. 231 entries. It resembles the name Kāśīnātha written there in the Lagnacandrikā entry. No line or arrow connects them.

after.evidence: The word may resemble the name Kāśīnātha used in the fol. 231 Lagnacandrikā entry and in r004. However, the note lies at about y≈2950–3200, roughly 600 px above that entry. It is approximately level with the fol. 231 lines e.125(3)/e.2 (Lakṣmīsahasranāma stotra / Lakṣmīsūkta), as judged from the reduced adjacent image. No line or arrow connects the note to either entry.

changes.reason: The earlier evidence implied a height correspondence with Lagnacandrikā that the source positions do not support. The attachment remains unresolved.

review.boundary_review: Writing beyond the gutter (x>~3215), namely the italic 'd' letters and the circled 'Bhav', belongs to fol. 231 and is correctly excluded. The 'n ?' and the partial oval 'the' visible at the left edge of the fol. 231 image correspond to target-page b003 and b004. They are not separate facing-page records. Faint mirrored writing across the page is show-through from fol. 230 recto. This includes faint marks at the bottom left (about [600,4730,330,90]), which probably mirror the recto's bottom-right pencil note ('printer skip page'). It is not target text.

region_review.top: Only the folio number (b001) is present; the rest is show-through.
region_review.middle: There is a small dark dot at about [1225,2360] that is a non-text mark. Otherwise only show-through appears.
region_review.bottom: b005 is at lower left and b004 is at lower right. Below them are faint mirrored show-through marks only, and no target writing was found.
region_review.left_margin: No independent writing apart from b005.
region_review.right_margin: b002, b003 and b004 are near the gutter. Everything beyond the gutter belongs to fol. 231.
region_review.interlinear: No interlinear additions beyond the recorded pencil notes.
